description: This Java class models an immutable representation of a configuration field, including parsing, size calculation, and code generation methods for TunerStudio and Java fields.

classes.name: ConfigField
classes.description: Immutable model of an individual configuration field with parsing, size, and code generation functionalities.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a line of text into a ConfigField object using regex matching.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the field, considering bit fields and arrays.

methods.name: getHeaderText
methods.description: Generates C header text for the field with offset and bit information.

methods.name: writeTunerStudio
methods.description: Writes configuration data for TunerStudio, updating position and handling different field types.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Generates Java code for the field, including enum options and field types.

methods.name: getCommentContent
methods.description: Returns the comment content, stripping comment tags if present.
